Abstract

We test methods-mcp section parsing with this minimal ar5iv-shaped fixture. Code: https://github.com/example/agentic-bench.

1. Introduction

This paper introduces a synthetic methodology for testing.

2. Methods

We perform a serial dilution of compound X starting at 10 mM into PBS buffer using a P200 pipette, in a 96-well plate. Cells are incubated at 37 C for 24 hours before luminescence readout on a SpectraMax M5 plate reader. Statistical analysis uses GraphPad Prism with one-way ANOVA.

3. Results

Dose response curves were monotonic across all replicates.
